name: public
title: Aloecraft — status
//: The public profile is an ALLOWLIST, and it is applied at collection.
A field absent from `include` is never written to status.json, so it
cannot be recovered by reading the file the page fetches.
Deliberately absent, each for a reason:
build.url, build.branch  name internal branches and expose which
workflows exist and how often they fail
activity (entirely)      commit subjects are unreviewed prose
mirror_generated_at      infrastructure timing, not a user fact
`status` is kept because a public status page that cannot say a build
is failing is not a status page.
